description: Signaleringskaart Aardgas (traces) is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoservices.zuid-holland.nl. The natural gas signalling map (traces) signals the locations of natural gas pipelines that are older than 30 years, or classified as 'replaceable'. The 'replaceable' category is based on materials such as asbestos and grey cast iron that have been collectively agreed to be removed. The natural gas pipelines are aggregated at neighbourhood level (CBS). Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Signalling map Natural gas (traces)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include infrastructuur, leidingen, gasleidingen. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WFS. The listing shows 2019-07-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
